traits.name: Minion
traits.description: The fighter's attacks can't critically hit, and they're immediately defeated when they suffer an injury.

traits.name: Hit and Run
traits.description: After the fighter hits with an attack on their turn, they can use the Disengage action as a free action.

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.description: At the start of each scene, if the fighter is in cover or terrain that obscures an enemy's primary sense, they can make a Stealth test (no action required) against each nearby enemy's Spiritual defense. Enemies they succeed against are Surprised until the end of the first round.

actions.name: Covering Fire
actions.description: The fighter makes a Hunting Bow attack against one target within 80 feet. Whether the attack hits or misses, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Discipline test or become Immobilized until the start of the fighter's next turn.

strikes.name: Hatchet
strikes.description: Attack +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Graze: 3 (1d6) keen damage. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) keen damage.

strikes.name: Hunting Bow
strikes.description: Attack +4, range 80/320 ft., one target. Graze: 3 (1d6) keen damage. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) keen damage.
